steps.content:
The assassination attempt on the FAC Commander-in-Chief has shaken the entire city-state. The FAC, Public Security Bureau, 9th Agency, and Paradeisos's HUSH Unit are conducting a joint investigation with astonishing efficiency. The goal is to eliminate all obstacles before the Black Ring Blockade Operation begins in August.

Under the coordination of Paradeisos's special envoy <color=#fb9259>Hush X</color>, the joint investigation team is closely tracking all suspicious individuals during the intelligence blockade. A list of suspects has been quickly identified.

Plus, more enemies have exposed themselves in the intense attack against X.

The operation is being carried out discreetly and swiftly. Most of the culprits are intelligence agents who have been bought out or implanted by the enemy. Through them, we've obtained further information about their handlers, and captured many Underground members.

The threat is gradually being eliminated, and the official Black Ring Blockade Operation can be launched soon.

The West District shall never be abandoned. We cannot repeat the same mistakes.

2:23 p.m., August 17th, N.F. 113
FAC Black Ring Blockade Operation Joint Command

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>The preparation for battle is going smoothly. The important thing now is intelligence security. If the plan for the Anti-Mania Blockade Network's core base gets leaked, the Underground will definitely strike without mercy.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Your decoy strategy has been very effective. They are in a very vulnerable position right now.</color>

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Understood. Since the HUSH system has already been compromised, my presence is the best bait for the Underground.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>On top of that, we need you to ensure your own safety. Though the substitute is about to take over, our strategy must remain consistent after the battle starts.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>At this stage, your </color><color=#fb9259>observations</color><color=#7683a2> are indispensable. Do not allow for any disruptions, or else our whole battle plan will be at risk.</color>

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Understood. I will hold out safely until the end of the battle and complete the handover. Plus, besides you, I also have Rahu protecting me. There won't be any problems.
Schorl spins around, scanning the black-clad guard nearby. She hears the conversation clearly, but shows no expression.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...That FAC has repeatedly overstepped our orders to her. Her behaviours in the recent kidnapping incident is an outrageous example.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Did something happen to the <color=#fb9259>mark</color> you gave her? Or was there a problem with the initial instructions?</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>She obviously overemphasizes her role as a "guard," which compromises her obedience as a result.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>In her loyalty test, she even submitted a so-called "action statement," claiming that if there were obstacles for specific missions, there's a chance that she might disobey orders, and warned us to be careful when using her. With this attitude...</color>
Shalom can't help but chuckle, unintentionally interrupting Schorl.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I think she's seriously creating her own user manual. That's exactly something Rahu would do. A tool that can actively provide a detailed "instruction manual" is more trustworthy, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...Indeed, someone specifically requested her.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>The threat from the Underground is growing day by day. The crisis that Hush faces will eventually fall on more people. There is a big shortage of capable guards... Do you agree with these statements?</color>
Shalom nods with a grin.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: She's very reliable and handy. After I leave, there will be many people who want her, so please help choose the most suitable position for her.
Schorl slowly opens its dark body as it stares at her, revealing the light blue core that once destroyed an FAC heavy armored vehicle in one hit and quietly scans the Sinner before it.
M-value fluctuation, safe. Emotional fluctuation, safe. Physiological indicators, stable. Mental activity level, high. Result: Hush is stable.
Shalom doesn't look up. She flips through the report in her hand with a smile and sips on warm water as she lets Schorl scan her inside out.

This is probably a Level 3 Scan. Teasing Schorl is pretty boring, but unfortunately, she can't tease anyone else now. As Schorl closes up again, Shalom shuts her eyes. The <color=#fb9259>channel</color> is open, and the <color=#fb9259>orders</color> have arrived.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The FAC operation plan has finally been approved, but the costs are still too high. Various forces in the city-state are disgruntled with this West District operation, and it will cost a lot to appease them.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Paradeisos is supporting them to achieve more important goals. All of them must be achieved. Thus, HUSH-X's observations and strategy are necessary.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The requirements are as follows:

1. Provide a plan to weed out all internal spies. Catch as many high-ranking Underground members as possible, and find the real entrance to the Underground.

2. Ensure the formation of the defense belt and closely monitor the defense network. If the Underground's Shepherd tries to break through, immediately lock their position and go for the kill at all costs. That will be the ultimate victory for humanity.

3. Ensure that BR-002 is completely controlled, and find a way to suppress it. The first goal is to strike the Underground. The second goal is to stimulate the city-state's economy. If the largest Black Ring in West District can become a new Hypercube mine, Nirvana will have fewer complaints.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: You've completed requirement 1 and 2. For requirement 3, there is an add-on requirement: you need to return to the <color=#fb9259>Observatorium</color> and confirm the direction in the Mania level.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: The situation is too chaotic. Too much risk and turbulence plagues West District. We should have directly used the Purge Order as planned in March. Let <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color> swallow BR-002 Corpus, then pacify both threats in one go with our <color=#fb9259>Rules</color>.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: We've invested so much yet ended up with a Black Ring that we can't control at all. West District is still in chaos, and every step we take is precarious. The change of plan was too radical, and <color=#fb9259>X</color>, she...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: She has validated the accuracy of the HUSH system, achieving mass mental observation and induction. She even accomplished our most important goal that we haven't been able to achieve for years... luring out the <color=#fb9259>Underground Shepherd</color>.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Corpus 02 has taken on a fixed form as the Black Ring. Once the defense network is established, all we need to do is prepare and wait. Humanity will have the upper hand. It will definitely try to come and swallow its prey, revealing its whereabouts in the process. As long as we eliminate this ultimate threat, everything will return to normal.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Each of you here has agreed to let her carry out the mission <color=#fb9259>regardless of the cost</color> out of your own rational judgment...

<color=#fb9259>??-others</color>: ...

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Agreed. If we need to change the plan, we can initiate a revision agenda. Pointless regret only corrodes rationality.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: This master plan's only setback is our failure to successfully recover <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color> as planned, and having him fall into the hands of an unknown faction. We are still in the execution phase of the plan, so <color=#fb9259>X</color> can continue to handle it.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Excellent. <color=#fb9259>X</color>, we'll leave it to you.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The research institute will synchronize all the data you observe. You also need to submit your plan for approval before it can be implemented. Schorl's alert level has gone up a level.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Your usage period is almost up. We need to help you control your own risks. Is that all right?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Of course. I can sense the expectations you have for me.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: The battle arrangements from the FAC have been synchronized. <color=#fb9259>HUSH-X</color> is ready, and will begin observation in one minute to confirm the status of BR-002.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: I shall complete the requirements as always.
